LanguageData.Gun_Cx4_Storm_RWP.description: The Cx4 Storm is a versatile semi-automatic carbine, known for its reliability and ease of use. Its compact design makes it ideal for close-quarters combat, offering a balanced mix of accuracy and firepower. Rugged enough for various environmental conditions, it's a favorite among colonies needing a dependable ranged weapon.
